temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. Gary declines Ethan's invitation to a weekend retreat, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was a dedicated and hardworking friend, but had not yet fully accepted how serious Gary's work-life imbalance might be.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Ethan's concern is confirmed: Gary's overwork is severe enough to threaten his health, and he is resistant to stepping away because of hospital obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is significantly overworked and at risk; his work obligations are overwhelming, and he may resist help, so Ethan needs to intervene carefully.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern and worry for Gary's health.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary rest and recover, encouraging him toward relaxation and considering how to support him despite his refusal.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work. Ethan suspects there is more to Gary's overworking than just professional obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is significantly overworked and at risk; his work obligations are overwhelming and he may resist help, so Ethan is looking for signs of what is really going on.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Gary's restlessness and avoidance suggest that his overwork is not caused only by hospital demands; there are likely deeper personal or emotional issues.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork is not just professional; he is carrying deeper personal or emotional burdens that he is avoiding discussing.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern mixed with suspicion and empathy.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently confront Gary and encourage him to open up, offering nonjudgmental support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. Ethan now understands the reasons behind Gary's behavior.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary's overwork is not just professional; he is carrying deeper personal or emotional burdens that he is avoiding discussing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, the event clarifies Ethan's suspicion: Gary's overwork is driven by specific pressures from managing a new department and personal challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork stems from new-department pressure and personal challenges; with practical support, he can improve his work-life balance.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relief that Gary opened up, along with empathy and continued concern.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule so he can make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports progress and remaining challenges, and says he has been less overwhelmed and even had time for a movie.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary's overwork stems from new-department pressure and personal challenges; with practical support, he can improve his work-life balance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Gary's reports and visible efforts reinforce that he is making meaningful progress, and Ethan's ongoing support appears to be helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making meaningful progress toward a healthier balance and is less overwhelmed, though some challenges remain.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, offering support, and encouraging Gary's progress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and appears capable of managing on his own. Gary thanks Ethan and says he feels more in control.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is making meaningful progress toward a healthier balance and is less overwhelmed, though some challenges remain.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, Gary has achieved a sustained healthier balance and can now manage independently; active intervention is no longer needed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has achieved a healthier work-life balance and can manage independently; Ethan's active support is no longer required, though he remains available.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfaction, happiness, and pride for Gary.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back and let Gary manage on his own, while letting him know Ethan is still available if needed.
